newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am offers post-holiday fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am offers post-holiday fare cuts.

text.p: Pan Am Corp said it would offer post-holiday fare reductions, following other major airlines trying to make the most out of a traditionally slow travel period.

"Just as the airline industry benefits greatly from the heavy demand for air travel during the year-end holidays, there is a large trough in the post-holiday period," said Martin Shugrue Jr, Pan Am's president and chief executive.
He said attractive pricing can stimulate demand and is the company's "post-holiday gift" to customers.

Economy fares on Pan Am's route network will be offered at $99 one way between New York and Los Angeles, $99 one way between New York and San Juan, $69 one way between New York and Miami and $79 one way between Miami and San Juan, plus applicable taxes, the company said.
The lower fares, available for travel from January 8 through March 21, must be secured by January 13. All fares are based on roundtrip purchase and contain certain other restrictions, Pan Am said.
